commit.message: fix(conport): eliminate 500s — ag_catalog schema ref, search UUID/Decimal serialization

pr.title: fix(conport): eliminate runtime 500s — schema ref + serialization — 102
pr.body: Fixes three certain runtime 500 errors: (a) changes schema='ag_catalog' to schema='public' at enhanced_server.py:206; (b) stringifies UUID id and Decimal rank in search_content JSON rows before serialization; (c) verifies unified_queries.py has no remaining ag_catalog references. Routes /api/search/<ws>, /api/unified-search, and /api/workspace-relationships should return 200 after this fix.

steps.task: Preflight: verify worktree, repo identity, and conport service is healthy (101 must have passed). Read enhanced_server.py lines 200-215 and 1420-1500, and all of unified_queries.py to understand the schema reference and serialization context.
validation: enhanced_server.py is readable and the ag_catalog reference at line ~206 is located.
search_content handler at lines ~1428-1495 is read and UUID/Decimal types identified.
unified_queries.py is read in full and all ag_catalog occurrences catalogued.

steps.task: Fix (a): In enhanced_server.py at line ~206, change schema='ag_catalog' to schema='public'. Verify the surrounding AGE graph query context to confirm this is the correct schema for the target PostgreSQL installation.
validation: grep -n ag_catalog enhanced_server.py shows no uncommented runtime reference at the target line.
The surrounding graph query context is preserved and logically consistent.
Python syntax check passes: python -m py_compile enhanced_server.py.

steps.task: Fix (b): In search_content handler (~enhanced_server.py:1428-1495), ensure UUID id fields are cast with str() and Decimal rank fields with float() before JSON serialization, or pass default=str to json.dumps. Preserve existing field structure and ordering.
validation: No TypeError: Object of type UUID is not JSON serializable can be raised by the handler.
No TypeError: Object of type Decimal is not JSON serializable can be raised by the handler.
Python syntax check passes: python -m py_compile enhanced_server.py.
Unit test (if any exist) for search_content still passes.

steps.task: Fix (c): Scan unified_queries.py for any ag_catalog schema references. If found in runtime query strings, change to public. If found only in comments or dead code, annotate as verified-dead. Record findings in proof.
validation: grep -n ag_catalog unified_queries.py output is fully accounted for in proof (each line is either fixed or annotated as comment/dead).
Python syntax check passes: python -m py_compile unified_queries.py.

steps.task: Smoke-test all three previously-500 routes against the running conport container. Record HTTP status codes in proof.
validation: All response codes recorded verbatim in proof/conport-optimal-102/.
